coreIntent: Improve visibility in Google Maps, local search results and AI-assisted local discovery so local businesses generate more calls, enquiries, bookings, direction requests, reviews and trust.
mandatoryTopics: AI search and local discovery readiness

sectionBriefs.hero: Write a persuasive hero for local business owners who want more calls, enquiries and visibility from local search.
sectionBriefs.quickAnswer: Explain what Local Business Visibility means in 40-60 words for business owners.
sectionBriefs.whatItMeans: Explain the service in practical commercial terms: maps, reviews, profiles, landing pages, citations and trust.
sectionBriefs.whyItMatters: Explain why poor local visibility costs businesses enquiries, calls and bookings.
sectionBriefs.whatWeOptimise: Cover profile accuracy, categories, services, reviews, photos, posts, landing pages, citations and trust signals.
sectionBriefs.process: Explain a clear step-by-step optimisation process.
sectionBriefs.results: Set realistic expectations around improved visibility, stronger trust signals and more enquiry opportunities.
sectionBriefs.faq: Answer commercial questions about cost, timescale, reviews, Google Maps, rankings and competition.
sectionBriefs.cta: Encourage the business owner to request a visibility review.

imagePrompts.hero: Professional local business owner reviewing map visibility, local search performance and customer enquiry dashboard.
imagePrompts.support: Marketing consultant optimising local business visibility with Google Maps, reviews, service categories and local search signals.
imagePrompts.trust: Customer reviews, ratings, local reputation, trust signals and map-pack style visibility for small businesses.
imagePrompts.conversion: Business growth from improved local visibility: more calls, bookings, reviews, direction requests and enquiries.
